title: roettlera glabra
intro: Roettlera glabra, commonly known as Wild Celery, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae, known for its distinctive celery-like appearance and fragrance. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Roettlera glabra include its potential to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory problems, and exhibit analgesic and anti-spasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
